summary_en: ¥1,350M, 300,000 shares (1.53% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), open-market purchase, execution window Aug 3–31, 2026. Rationale: capital efficiency and enhanced shareholder returns, citing 11 consecutive periods of record sales and 8 consecutive periods of record operating/ordinary profit.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On July 31, 2026, Kohsoku Corporation (ticker 7504, TSE Prime) announced a board resolution to acquire up to 300,000 of its own common shares (1.53% of shares outstanding, calculated as 300,000 ÷ 19,553,337 ex-treasury shares) for an upper limit of ¥1,350 million. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from August 3 to August 31, 2026.

The company stated the rationale as enhancing capital efficiency and enriching shareholder returns. It cited strong financial performance: in the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales achieved an 11th consecutive all-time high, operating and ordinary profit reached an 8th consecutive all-time high, and net income attributable to parent company shareholders achieved a 5th consecutive all-time high. In Q1 of fiscal 2027 (ended June 30, 2026), sales and profit items exceeded the prior-year period, with operating and ordinary profit running at approximately 140% of the prior-year level.

As of June 30, 2026, the company held 1,437,583 treasury shares against a total issued share count (excluding treasury) of 19,553,337 shares.
